==Biography==
Nguyễn '''Slayder''' Linh Vương joined [[E.Hub United]] as a trainee ADC, along with [[Kiaya]], [[Ciel (Trần Tiến Thịnh)|Ciel]], and [[Victory]]. Seen as an extremely skilled ADC, highly aggressive but always manages to farm, keep position and stay alive in combats. He is considered to be the best ADC in Vietnam.

=== 2018 Season ===
Slayder joined [[FTV Esports]] on Sep, 2017. Then FTV Esports acquired the slot of E.Hub United and finished 6th at [[VCS 2018 Spring]]. Despite failing to make the playoffs, Slayder proved himself to be one of the Vietnamese best ADC.
After spring split, he decided to join [[Sky Gaming]] in order to play under [[Optimus]], this decision has been dispraised by the fans as well as his old teammates, especially FTV Esports' owner, [[Huỳnh Phương]].

=== 2019 Season ===
Sky Gaming had finally made it to [[VCS 2019 Spring]] and then finished 3rd, losing to [[EVOS Esports]] at Playoffs Round 2. Slayder's performance earned him a spot on the Roster of the Season, finished 2nd on the MVP Ranking, just 1 games behind [[Zeros]].
Sky Gaming rosters and slot were acquired by [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]], playing along with [[Stark (Phan Công Minh)|Stark]], [[YiJin]], this team was considered to a dream team of VCS, aiming for a direct seed to [[2019 Season World Championship<!--/Main Event-->|2019 Season World Championship Main Event]]. However, after a 2nd place finish in in the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season| Summer Season]] the team would first lose to [[GAM Esports]] 3-0 in the Grand Final, before losing 3-1 to [[Lowkey Esports.Vietnam|Lowkey Esports]], failing to qualify for the [[2019 Season World Championship<!--/Main Event-->|2019 Season World Championship Main Event]].

=== 2020 Season ===
After the disappointment of not qualifying for Worlds [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] acquired [[Yoshino]] from [[GAM Esports]], '''Slayder''' would be the only ADC, supported by [[CBL]] as both [[Artemis (Trần Quốc Hưng)|Artemis]] and [[Hinn]] left the Team. [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] would again finish 2nd in the [[VCS 2020 Spring|Regular Season]], being the only team to win more than one map against the dominant [[GAM Esports]]. However, this time [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] would succeed in the Grand Final against [[GAM Esports]] winning the series 3-2 largely due to the performance of '''Slayder'''.

== Trivia ==
* Reached Rank 3 on the Vietnamese soloqueue ladder when he was 15.
*Known for his {{ci|Kai'Sa}}
*He was awarded the title of National Esports Grandmaster by VIRESA (Vietnam Esports Federation) after achieving good results with [[GAM Esports]] at [[2023_Season_World_Championship|Worlds 2023]] on January 21, 2024.
